title: Caño cristales (La Macarena).jpg
author: Ricardo Gonzalez Arango
description: A Colombian river located in the Serrania de la Macarena. It has a wide variety of aquatic plants. Almost unique is the bright red - pink coloration of riverbed after the rainy period in the end of June - November. This color is caused by great quantities of endemic plant species Macarenia clavígera.
